authorized_representative.quote: Landlord designates Dana Reyes as the sole representative authorized to deliver and receive notices, grant consents and execute amendments on Landlord’s behalf under this Lease.

base_rent_monthly.quote: The initial Monthly Base Rent is $18,500.00 per month.

cam_estimate_psf_annual.quote: Landlord’s current estimate of Operating Expenses is $11.50 per rentable square foot per annum, payable in monthly installments of $5,941.67 concurrently with Base Rent.

commencement.quote: The term of this Lease (the “Term”) shall commence on January 1, 2024 (the “Commencement Date”)

escalation_amount.quote: Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date and on each anniversary thereafter during the Term, the Monthly Base Rent shall increase by 3.00% per annum.

escalation_kind.quote: Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date and on each anniversary thereafter during the Term, the Monthly Base Rent shall increase by 3.00% per annum.

expiration.quote: shall expire at 11:59 p.m. on December 31, 2028 (the “Expiration Date”)

proportionate_share_pct.quote: Tenant’s Proportionate Share is 9.69%, computed as the rentable area of the Premises divided by the rentable area of the Building.

renewal_count.quote: Provided no event of default is then continuing, Tenant shall have one (1) option to extend the Term, each for an additional period of 3 years, on all of the terms and conditions of this Lease except that Base Rent during each extension period shall be determined under Section 11.3.

renewal_notice_days.quote: Each option shall be exercised, if at all, by written notice delivered to Landlord not less than 270 days prior to the then-current Expiration Date.

renewal_years.quote: Provided no event of default is then continuing, Tenant shall have one (1) option to extend the Term, each for an additional period of 3 years, on all of the terms and conditions of this Lease except that Base Rent during each extension period shall be determined under Section 11.3.

rentable_sf.quote: The Premises are stipulated to contain 6,200 rentable square feet.

security_deposit.quote: Concurrently with Tenant’s execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of $37,000.00 as a security deposit for the faithful performance of Tenant’s obligations hereunder.

uncertain: Extension-period Base Rent (Section 11.3, page 7) is the greater of the final-month Base Rent and 95% of a fair market rental rate to be determined by Landlord and Tenant; the market rate is not stated, so first-year extension rent cannot be derived and was not computed.
Section 11.1 grants one (1) option but uses 'each' wording ('each for an additional period of 3 years'); extracted as one option of 3 years — confirm no additional options were intended.

Verified the Base Rent Schedule on page 3 is consistent with $18,500.00 escalating 3.00% annually, and the $5,941.67 monthly operating expense installment equals $11.50 x 6,200 RSF / 12. No amendment language and no embedded instructions were found in the document.
